_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 07 비교 표현에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 심화 8과 비교구문 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 비교급 강조: much, even, still, far, a lot (very 불가)

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: My older brother plays the guitar as ______ as the piano.

choices.text: good
well
better
more well
best

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: The more you read, ______ it becomes.

choices.text: easier
easy
easiest
the easier
the easy

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: Mina looks ______ happier in the yellow hat than the white one.

choices.text: very
much
even
still
far

questions.prompt: 다음 중 문맥상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: Autumn is not so hot as summer.
My score is as better as the last test.
The blue cap is cheaper than the red one.
The museum is the oldest building in this town.
The singer was much more amazing than I had seen on TV.

questions.prompt: 다음 주어진 문장과 같은 의미의 문장을 고르세요.
body: Mina’s bike is not as new as mine.

choices.text: My bike is as new as Mina’s.
My bike is newer than Mina’s.
Mina’s bike is newer than mine.
My bike is not so new as Mina’s.
Mina’s bike is not older than mine.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The traffic is a lot [[bad as]] I expected.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: I arrived [[the earliest]] today than any other day.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: One of the greatest inventions is the wheel.
The line was even longer than usual this morning.
Jason is one of the more talented actor in the world.
The more you walk, the healthier your body becomes.
The car went more and more fast until it reached the hill.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작하지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: 오늘 날씨는 어제만큼 춥지 않다. → The weather today is not as cold as yesterday.
음악을 지금보다 조금 더 작게 틀어줄 수 있니? → Can you play the music a little more quietly than now?
그 가게의 사과 파이는 내가 만든 것보다 달다. → The bakery’s apple pie is as sweet as mine.
우리 아빠는 나에게 세상에서 가장 소중한 사람이다. → My dad is the most precious person in the world to me.
이 영화는 올해 가장 인기 있는 영화들 중 하나이다. → This movie is one of the most popular films of the year.

questions.prompt: 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 같지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: Jay doesn’t draw as well as Mike. = Mike draws better than Jay.
My cat cannot jump as high as yours. = Your cat can jump higher than mine.
My sister learns more quickly than the other students. = The other students learn as quickly as my sister.
As we got to know Mia more, we started to like her more. = The more we knew about Mia, the more we started to like her.
As winter gets closer, more people go to the mountains. = The closer winter gets, the more people go to the mountains.

questions.prompt: 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 같지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: I’m the youngest person in my family. = No other person in my family is younger than I am.
Tea is the most delicious drink to me. = No other drink is as delicious as tea to me.
Henry is the fastest runner in the team. = No other runner is faster than Henry in the team.
The panda is the most popular animal in the zoo. = Other animals are as popular as the panda in the zoo.
Erica sings better than any other person among my friends. = Erica sings the best among my friends.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: ⓐ Doing homework is more important than play games.
ⓑ The park is about three times as far as the market.
ⓒ Air pollution in big cities is getting even more serious.
ⓓ The more the team scored goals, the louder the cheers got.
ⓔ These bags are most expensive bags in this store.
ⓕ We need to save time as more as possible for the trip.
